purpose: Ex-ante definition of five orthogonal OHLCV candidate mechanisms before any new performance evaluation.
implementation_integrity_revision: 2026-09-28: corrected return-window indexing to exclude the next session; no hypothesis or parameter changed.

candidates.name: LOW_MAX_21
candidates.definition: Long bottom-2 by maximum daily close-to-close return over 21 sessions.

candidates.name: LOW_IDIO_VOL_273
candidates.definition: Long bottom-2 by 273-session residual volatility versus equal-weight universe return.

candidates.name: LONG_TERM_REVERSAL_756
candidates.definition: Long bottom-2 by 756-session cumulative close return.

candidates.name: TREND_EFFICIENCY_63
candidates.definition: Long top-2 by absolute 63-session net return divided by summed absolute daily returns.

candidates.name: VOLUME_CONFIRMED_TREND_126
candidates.definition: Long top-2 by 126-session return times 21-session average volume divided by prior 126-session average volume.

De Bondt & Thaler (1985), Does the Stock Market Overreact?, DOI 10.1111/j.1540-6261.1985.tb05004.x
Lee & Swaminathan (2000), Price Momentum and Trading Volume, DOI 10.1111/0022-1082.00280
Jegadeesh & Titman (1993), Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers, DOI 10.1111/j.1540-6261.1993.tb04702.x
